report.question: Message
report.wanted: Investigate this synthetic shop incident. [QA] Paid social clicks and product views remained stable. [QB] Immediately after a checkout deployment, card authorisation failures rose sharply for all product categories. [QC] Rolling the deployment back restored successful payments while traffic stayed steady. What explanation is supported, and what remains uncertain?
